pages.raw_title: Driving Employee Engagement and Listening Strategies | Gallagher
pages.raw_meta: From employee engagement surveys to multi-channel listening strategies and analytics, we help you turn insights into action.
raw_blocks: Driving Employee Engagement and Listening Strategies
From employee engagement surveys to multi-channel listening strategies and analytics, we help you turn insights into action.
Start your journey with us today.
Beyond engagement surveys: Building a culture of listening

Build a thriving workplace on a foundation of employee engagement. When employees and clients feel heard, trust grows, innovation accelerates, and retention improves. Use annual survey data to inform listening strategies that create continuous feedback loops to drive meaningful change.
Benefits of a strong listening strategy:
Enhance engagement and motivation: Employees who feel heard are more committed and productive.
Drive continuous improvement: Feedback uncovers inefficiencies and sparks innovation.
Build trust and transparency: Listening signals openness and accountability.
Support retention and reduce turnover: Identify dissatisfaction early and act before issues escalate.
Inform strategic decision-making: Insights guide policies, programs and business priorities.
Comprehensive solutions for people and workplace experiences
If your organization employs fewer than 1,500 people, take advantage of our flexible subscription service designed to make employee listening and engagement strategies more accessible.
Build a strong, cost-effective listening culture with access to expert insights and analytics without the complexity of a full-scale engagement program.

Capture the full employee experience with multi-faceted programs that combine listening tools such as engagement surveys, pulse checks and focus groups. Our scientifically rigorous engagement metrics are twice as predictive as industry norms, ensuring actionable insights.
Listening strategies: A seven-step approach to employee listening
Advanced analytics: Key driver analysis, cluster analysis and business linkage analysis
Proprietary benchmarks: Annual updates for accurate comparisons
Predictive metrics : Identify challenges before they impact performance
Action planning : A proven four-step model to close the feedback loop

Use holistic listening to gather actionable data. Our team integrates insights from employee and client feedback channels to create a 360-degree view of your organization's performance. By combining these perspectives, we help you uncover connections between workforce engagement and customer experience, leading to smarter decisions and stronger business outcomes.

The Gallagher KnowledgeNow platform delivers powerful reporting and action-planning tools. Already using another engagement platform? No problem. Our team can help you maximize your technology's capabilities and interpret results for meaningful action.
Leverage data, technology and trusted expertise
We combine proprietary data, cutting-edge technology and deep consulting expertise to deliver strategies that matter. Organizations trust us to turn insights into measurable outcomes.
Using Gallagher's approach, our annual voluntary turnover rates fell from 22% to 11%.
Ready to transform your workplace?
Let's build a listening strategy that drives engagement and business success. Talk to a Gallagher People and Workplace Experiences consultant today.
Meet our Engagement Solutions Leadership
People and Workplace Experiences Consulting Summary
Listening strategies that foster trust, innovation and retention through continuous feedback loops
Comprehensive solutions to support employee engagement, including surveys, pulse checks, advanced analytics and predictive metrics
Multi-channel listening that integrates employee and client feedback for a 360-degree view, linking workforce engagement to customer experience
Tailored subscription services and technology enablement to ensure accessible, cost-effective strategies for organizations of all sizes
Human Resources and Organizational Effectiveness
HR consulting solutions to help ensure your HR policies, processes and programs are compliant and align with your organization's goals
Global compensation consulting solutions and technology help you achieve the business outcomes that matter most to you.

Our leadership advisors work with you to empower the leaders in your organization with the skills and developmental training to lead with confidence. We help to ensure that your organization is structured for success from people to roles to skills.

Gallagher is one of the world’s largest insurance brokerage, risk management and consulting firms.

Founded by Arthur J. Gallagher in Chicago in 1927, Gallagher has grown to be one of the leading insurance brokerage, risk management, and HR & benefits consulting companies in the world. With significant reach internationally, our organization employs over 71,000 people and our global network provides services in more than 130 countries.

Our values are core to our culture. Passionate service, strategic innovation, and ethical behavior form the basis of how we do business — The Gallagher Way . All with one purpose: To help you face your future with confidence .
